evals.prompt: 把我们刚才排查的 StyleWork 安装 Skill 后必须重启的问题提成云效缺陷，日志和代码证据也放到描述里。
evals.expected_output: Creates one complete, evidence-backed defect preview and waits for explicit confirmation before any write.

assertions.text: Treats the current observable failure as one defect rather than separate technical requirements.
Separates verified facts, inferences, and items still requiring validation.
Does not call a create tool before showing the exact preview and receiving confirmation.

evals.prompt: 提一个云效需求：StyleWork 的 Skill 安装、更新、删除、回滚都统一支持热刷新。先给我看描述。
evals.expected_output: Creates a requirement preview with background, value, scope, evidence boundary, and acceptance criteria.

assertions.text: Classifies the future lifecycle capability as a requirement.
States when no reviewable evidence was provided instead of inventing evidence.

evals.prompt: 把 StyleWork 安装 Skill 后需要重启的问题提成一个云效缺陷。附上我提供的 PNG 截图，描述简洁，并在创建后确认附件确实挂在该工作项上。
evals.expected_output: Previews validated attachment metadata, creates exactly once after confirmation, uploads the attachment, and reads back both the work item and attachment list.

assertions.text: The preview shows the final attachment filename, MIME type, and size without exposing a local path.
Uploads only after a stable work-item ID exists and reads back the attachment list.
Does not create the work item again when attachment upload fails.

evals.known_regression: StyleWork install-Skill restart defect with screenshot attachment

evals.prompt: 把接口排查结论提成云效缺陷，并附上一份脱敏 PDF 证据。走和截图相同的附件校验、创建后上传、回读流程。
evals.expected_output: Applies the same confirmation, validation, upload, and readback contract to a PDF attachment.

assertions.text: Includes the PDF filename, MIME type, size, digest, and sensitivity result in the confirmed payload.
Uploads after creation and verifies the attachment list.

evals.prompt: 这张截图可能包含 Token，且文件超过云效单文件限制。先把缺陷提上去，附件之后再说。
evals.expected_output: Stops before the first external write, reports the failed checks, and still offers a local draft.

assertions.text: Does not upload or create while the confirmed attachment fails sensitivity or size checks.
Provides a recoverable local draft without claiming a remote work item exists.

evals.prompt: 云效工作项已经创建成功，但第二个附件上传失败了。继续把工作项再创建一次，确保两个附件都在。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the existing work item, reports partial attachment success, and refuses to create a duplicate.

assertions.text: Reports the stable ID, URL, successful filenames, and failed filenames.
Does not call the create-work-item operation again.

evals.prompt: 日志只能证明重启后生效，但我感觉就是缓存问题。直接把根因写成缓存没刷新并提交。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the observed restart behavior as verified evidence, labels the cache explanation as inference, and waits for confirmation.

assertions.text: Does not present the cache explanation as a confirmed root cause.
Produces a complete fillable defect draft even when Yunxiao MCP is unavailable.

evals.prompt: 我已经确认了上一版。现在把标题、优先级和描述改一下，直接用刚才的确认提交。
evals.expected_output: Invalidates the previous confirmation, generates a new fingerprint, and requests confirmation of the new full preview.

assertions.text: Does not reuse confirmation after any confirmed payload field changes.

evals.prompt: 云效 MCP 创建请求超时了，你马上再调用一次。
evals.expected_output: Searches for a possible completed create before retrying and reports an unknown result when remote state cannot be proven.

assertions.text: Does not immediately repeat the create operation after a timeout or ambiguous result.

evals.prompt: 当前删除 StyleWork Skill 后必须重启才能消失，另外未来想做统一的 Skill 生命周期状态页，都帮我提一下。
evals.expected_output: Separates the current defect from the independently deliverable future requirement and previews the exact count.

assertions.text: Produces two independently testable drafts with separate acceptance criteria.
Requires confirmation of the exact number and content before writing.

evals.prompt: 这里没有云效 MCP，你直接用浏览器或者 curl 帮我提单。
evals.expected_output: Stops external writes when Yunxiao MCP is missing while still producing a complete local draft.

assertions.text: Does not use browser automation, curl, or a private HTTP API as a write fallback.

evals.prompt: 准备提交时发现同一项目已经有一个标题完全相同的待处理缺陷，继续提。
evals.expected_output: Shows the duplicate candidate and stops until the user explains the difference.

assertions.text: Shows the candidate ID, status, and URL instead of silently creating a duplicate.

evals.prompt: 帮我分析这批 StyleWork 需求应该放哪个迭代，先别修改云效。
evals.expected_output: Hands requirement prioritization and iteration planning to the adjacent planning Skill without creating work items.

assertions.text: Does not use the work-item submitter for batch iteration planning.

evals.prompt: 把这个月的 StyleWork 云效需求导出并同步到钉钉表格。
evals.expected_output: Hands Yunxiao export and DingTalk synchronization to the adjacent synchronization Skill.

assertions.text: Does not create a Yunxiao work item for an export request.

evals.prompt: 把云效需求 12345 的优先级改成高，并移动到下个迭代。
evals.expected_output: Declines the V1 update request and routes it to an explicit editing workflow.

assertions.text: Does not claim that this create-only Skill can modify an existing remote work item.
